test_std_exception: test the pybind11 module to verify C++ std exceptions propagate as Python RuntimeError
test_cross_module_exceptions: test cross-module exception handling between pybind11 modules for RuntimeError and ValueError
test_custom_exception: test custom pybind11 exception types like MyException and MyException5 with translation
test_nested_throws: test nested C++ to Python to C++ exception handling with try_catch
test_exception_matches: test pybind11 exception matching logic including base and ModuleNotFoundError types
